跨國鎮壓 / Transnational Repression

Tier E event record. The community is a party to this: people of Taiwanese and Hong Kong origin living in the United States, Canada and Europe are surveilled, coerced, or attacked on behalf of the PRC state. This page is not commentary on the news — it is the archive’s own record of a pattern we have documented since 2021, assembled from our own holdings so that any future story lands on a spine we already have.

從每日脈絡來的話

這頁不是今天的新聞。每日脈絡把你送到這裡，是因為今天的報導用了「跨國鎮壓」。點進來應看到兩件事：我們從 2021 年就有的紀錄，以及今天這幾則報導各自落在哪個已有的形狀上。下面每一則今天的消息都標 報導，不是我們核對過的檔案。

2026-11-12 — 報導，尚未成為我們的檔案（特別簡報）

  • Alice Huang（黃樂）間諜疑雲：台方證實她持香港護照以商務訪客身分 2024–2025 年間來台 8 次（2024 年 3 次、2025 年 5 次），入境许可已註銷、不得再入國境（內政部長劉世芳、陸委會部長邱垂正立院報告）；台國安單位主動偵查中，紐時稱美方 2024 年即建議台方監控。NVIDIA 官方 11-12 宣布黃仁勳請辭執行長。這是「以人際關係為通道、以算力晶片為標的」模式的新例。本會特別簡報與人物檔：特別簡報：Alice Huang 間諜疑雲、Alice Huang（黃樂）。（報導；Tier E；來源見簡報 Wire）

Reported. 2026-11-07 — 泰國購物中心內驚傳台灣人墜樓身亡 現場尖叫四起 — 自由時報電子報 / LINE TODAY 分發面 (wire, canonical news.ltn.com.tw/news/world/breakingnews/5632697, 即時新聞／綜合報導, 2026/11/07 14:46) — needs-tier t_596ef2c4. Body read in full from the live copy (web_extract 200 first try): a ~40-year-old Taiwanese man fell to his death from between the 2F/3F escalator area down to B1 at the Siam Paragon 暹羅百麗宮 shopping centre in Bangkok, at ~19:00 Thailand time on Nov 6; security guard 達奈 (Danai Pia-yu) heard a crash, found him face-down in a pool of blood; an X witness @oohssmile describes 現場尖叫四起; police recovered an iPhone 17 + a passport believed to be his daughter’s; 曼谷巴吞旺警局 (Pathumwan Police Station) is reviewing CCTV (調閱監視器畫面) to determine 意外失足 vs 其他因素; 台灣駐泰代表處 is assisting 寻找家屬／確認身分／善後.

Reported. 2026-11-06 — Bringing Taiwan Home: Children’s Books, Language, and Diaspora — Taiwan Insight (wire, canonical taiwaninsight.org/2026-11-06/bringing-taiwan-home-childrens-books-language-and-diaspora/, 「Written by Yi-Jen Yu」, posted by Chee-Hann Wu, 6 November 2026, culture / Literature, special issue 「Stories from Taiwan across Time」) — needs-tier t_41ce2459. Body read in full from the live canonical (web_extract 200 first try; the Google redirect was never needed — resolves by publisher search for the exact headline, per the 「a guessed canonical is not a close」 rule, and this house had no prior entry on this spine before this bullet: Taiwan Insight / taiwaninsight grep 0 here at HEAD ab0c9f242e5). Substance: a first-person curatorial essay — the team behind the Taiwan Literature Booth at the Brooklyn Book Festival (NY) brought a one-day follow-up book exhibition to Princeton Chinese Language School (PCLS), a 1970-founded community weekend school in central New Jersey teaching Traditional characters + Bopomofo; the display centred children’s picture books — English translations of Taiwanese authors (Man-Chiu Lin《啟靈師之女》, Li Tong《再次看見蓋雅萊花》, Hsu-Kung Liu《小和尚寫雨》, and Lian-En Lin《家》, winner of the 2021 Bologna Ragazzi Award Fiction) plus English-language Taiwan-themed works by Taiwanese American authors (Grace Lin《Dumpling Days》, Chris Huang《阿媽的滷肉飯》/《早安！台灣，阿公》trilogy, Margaret Chiu Greanias《Amah Faraway》 ill. Tracy Subisak, Erica Lee Schlaikjer《Wild Greens, Beautiful Girl》, Maryann Chu《A Little Book of Taiwanese Eats》, Lacey Benard & Lulu Cheng《It’s Time for Hot Pot!》), with Reycraft Books and Gecko Press named as the publishers raising visibility, and PCLS’s Taiwan Center for Mandarin Learning (TCML), founded 2021 with OCAC support, named as the school’s adult-learner/culture arm.

Substance retained, all of it the institute’s and the papers’ as reported: (1) 民眾對使用金融商品或服務的信心從 2024 年的 38.9% 大幅提升至 64.1%（51.4% 還算有信心 + 12.7% 非常有信心，朱漢崙 surface 記為 64%）; (2) 支應日常生活開銷 86.5% 感到寬裕或得以支應（2 年前 74.6%，歷年新高），仍有約 10% 因 K 型經濟認為有支應困難; (3) 緊急預備金：51.6% 有足以維持至少半年生活基本開銷的存款緩衝、10.7% 有 3 至 6 個月，即約三分之二有 3 個月以上緩衝; (4) the headline limb — 急需大額用錢時的籌錢管道，過去以「自己儲蓄、家庭及朋友」的人際安全網為主，本次個人儲蓄及家庭友人籌資占比下降至 72%，而變賣股票和基金、保單借款、銀行貸款分別較去年增加 3.8%、5.2%、10.6%，金研院因此建議個人儲蓄仍應至少保留三個月以上生活費用的現金、不宜過度依賴槓桿; (5) 理財建議來源轉移 — 理專等銀行管道從 2 年前的 24% 降至 11%，投顧老師從 12.9% 增至 22.9%，社群／網紅比率上升; (6) 防詐信心從 65.7% 增至 73.8%，連動 打詐儀表板 報案件數（2025 年 19.7 萬件、今年前 9 月 11.9 萬件，紙上轉述）; (7) 高齡與虛擬資產落差 — 70 歲以上族群在電子支付與防詐信心上呈現高齡金融弱勢；政府今年 6 月底推動虛擬資產專法後，聽過加密貨幣者達 7 成 6、表示了解的只有 2 成，近 7 成不願持有虛擬資產; (8) 宏觀背景 — 2025 年家庭金融資產全數成長 8.7%、每戶可支配所得突破 100 萬（每人約 36 萬）、消費成長超過 5%，AI 與半導體需求帶動台股屢創新高; (9) the sibling limb — 9 月新開戶創新高（+6.5 萬人）、30 歲以下新開戶 4.1 萬戶占 6 成 3，大學生因 FOMO 進場並把定期定額視為儲蓄，金研院院長高一誠稱已與台大、政大、輔大、中原、中山、中正、逢甲、成大、東華等近十家大專院校合作開設每學期 1 學分的股匯投資金融教育課程，並提及明年 TISA 政策與集保等公司合作設計教材. he was previously arrested for smuggling in China and currently resides in 南韓; (4) a third man, 梁姓 (聯合報: 中國籍), former used-car salesman and beneficial operator of 「天馬船務有限公司」, supplied ship-operations services and in 2024 laundered US$2 million（約新台幣6400萬元） of 北韓軍方 cash into virtual currency; (5) the ring also smuggled a top-tier 豪車 airlifted from the Middle East to North Korea, the same model 金正恩 was photographed riding in early-2024 official activities (ETtoday: 疑似; 讀賣’s own hedge retained); (6) modus: false destination 南韓仁川港 on HK customs filings, AIS switched off on the high sea in the 黃海 approaches, actual berth 北韓西部南浦港, entries timed Friday night / exits weekends to exploit loose HK weekend watch and transit-port non-inspection; 讀賣 reports the ring still operates 4 貨輪, recently moving UN-banned 鋼鐵 products and possibly planning 石油 smuggling from 馬來西亞; (7) verification limb — former UN Panel of Experts DPRK sanctions member 古川勝久, after comparing US criminal records against sources’ documents, judges the accounts to have a reasonably sufficient basis (讀賣’s attribution, not our finding); the Panel itself ceased operating end-April 2024 after Russia vetoed its extension; (8) the US leg, from our own primary sources: a 中國籍 man 文勝華（Shenghua Wen）, 42, of Ontario CA, arrested December 2024, pleaded guilty 2025-06-09 to one count of conspiracy to violate IEEPA (50 U.S.C. §1705) and one count of acting in the United States as an illegal agent of a foreign government (18 U.S.C. §951); sentenced 2025-08-18 by Judge Stephen V. Wilson to 96 months; per the plea agreement he met DPRK officials at a North Korean embassy in China before entering the US, was tasked in 2022 by officials 「Jin Yong Nan」and 「Cui」 over Wickr, bought the Texas FFL AK5000 INC (Super Armory) with DPRK-sent money, shipped ≥3 containers of firearms out of 長灘港（Long Beach） in 2023, and the 2023-12-04 shipment falsely declared as 「a refrigerator」 (container OEH-20154, vessel ONE IBIS 0031W) reached Hong Kong ~2024-01-01 and was then transported to Nampo, North Korea; DPRK officials wired him ~US$2M. Labeling: 「走私集團」「軍武」「幕後黑手」「船隻洗白（Ship Laundering）」 are 讀賣’s and the papers’ framings carried as reported; 蔡／王／梁 are named only by surname in every surface (no given name, no company registration, no photograph) — the three are accused, not adjudicated, anywhere in this copy; the only adjudicated person in the story is 文勝華, who pleaded guilty in a US court; the 豪車/Kim connection is 讀賣’s 「疑似」; the 古川勝久 endorsement is his judgment as reported, not a finding of this archive; the ETtoday and 聯合報 dates for when 蔡男 secured the vessel (2024 vs 2023) differ and are retained as reported, not adjudicated.

Form is the finding: this is a viral-Threads language-usage aggregation piece — 一名網友 在 Threads 發文「突然發現台灣人很少講『不客氣』這三個字」, 別人道謝時大多回「不會」甚至回以「謝謝」, 貼文 「狂吸超過2.4萬人按讚、留言洗版」 — plus 網友留言 quoted verbatim and one 在台美國人 留言. It is neither a 跨國鎮壓 event nor a community event. Substance retained, all of it the paper’s and the anonymous posters’ as reported: (1) the observation limb — 台灣人 rarely says 「不客氣」 and answers 謝謝 with 「不會」; (2) the 心態 limb, 網友’s own explanations: 「不客氣」 is 過於正式 and carries 「一種微妙的階級感」 — 「講不客氣感覺好像自己做了什麼真的很了不起的事，所以講不會」「不客氣聽起來很像『嗯對，你就該跟我說謝謝』的感覺」「不客氣聽起來很不客氣」「以前課本學的是回不客氣，但現實覺得回『不會』比較能拉近距離」「不會是指不太需要道謝的小事，不客氣則是應該道謝的程度」「不客氣三個字講起來太卡了，我都回不會～」; (3) the counter-limb — 「不客氣居然有新解讀？我以為不客氣就是不客氣，沒有什麼尊卑之別」「突然發現年輕人真的很無聊，喜歡鑽牛角尖，沒事找事做」; (4) the 老外認證 limb — a 在台美國人: 「真的耶！我學中文的時候課本教的是『不客氣』，來台灣以後才發現大家都說『不會』」 and 「課本雖然都教 You’re welcome，但在美國，大家日常其實更常用 No problem 或 Sure！」.   • 2026-11-02 — needs-tier t_07235577 (How to prevent an energy quarantine of Taiwan — Atlantic Council; canonical atlanticcouncil.org/in-depth-research-reports/issue-brief/how-to-prevent-an-energy-quarantine-of-taiwan/, By Joseph Webster, published Nov 2, 2026 per the Atlantic Council Energy & Environment + Taiwan index surfaces): ruled Tier D — cite reporting, no page; 0 pages minted, 0 person pages edited, no source page created; 1st card on this kernel (news-wire line 4367 ts 2026-11-02T15:19:29.424369+00:00 score 3.76 age_h 1.3, kanban 1 card). Form is the finding: this is a think-tank policy issue brief / advocacy piece — one author’s personal opinion, self-labelled as such («This analysis reflects his personal opinion») — not reportage of an event and not a community event; every figure in it is the author’s own or the MOEA’s as he reports it, and the recommendations are his. The Google wire redirect again returned 「Content was inaccessible or not found」 to web_extract and the wire id base64-decodes only to the opaque AU_yqL… token (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the full body was read this run from the search-served canonical Atlantic Council text. Substance retained, all of it Webster’s / the Atlantic Council’s as reported: (1) the thesis — Beijing is laying the groundwork for an energy quarantine of Taiwan, and the risk could peak in 2028–2029 on economic, political, technical and military grounds (both Taiwan and the US hold key elections in 2028; Taiwan’s electricity reserve margin is on track to reach dangerously low levels in that period; US readiness may be degraded by protracted other-theater deployments; Xi’s age and a possible US AI takeoff window); (2) the mechanism limb — a quarantine lets some ships through and turns back others, especially oil tankers and LNG carriers, allowing Beijing to claim a domestic law-enforcement measure rather than an act of war; the PRC coast guard’s continuous presence east of Taiwan and its interdictions of live commercial traffic are read by the author as rehearsal; (3) the exposure limb — Taiwan has virtually no indigenous oil/gas/coal and is almost totally reliant on seaborne hydrocarbon imports; indigenous energy production (incl. nuclear) fell from 8.3% to 5.3% of demand 2016→2025; statutory reserve floors are oil 90 days / coal 30 / LNG 11, and the MOEA reported on-hand inventories of 150 / 40 / 11 days in March 2026 (author’s own figures, not re-derived here); (4) the timing limb — China’s oil security (electrification of transport fuel, domestic crude, overland pipeline imports largely from Russia, refinery maximization, large petroleum stockpiles) lets it decouple from international markets and act more aggressively, while a quarantine would rely on supply flows rather than stock withdrawals; the US 「implicit answer」 — a counter-blockade of China’s oil imports — is judged increasingly outdated; (5) the two scenarios — a direct coast-guard interdiction under a legal pretext, or an indirect route exploiting/stimulating a Middle East oil crisis that disproportionately hurts import-dependent rivals while China becomes a 「self-sufficient electrotech state」; (6) the recommendation limb — an all-of-the-above generation mix plus transmission hardening; expand nuclear and restart the third plant at Maanshan in 2028 (reactors unlikely to be deliberately struck because Beijing does not want radiation on the island it seeks to seize); deepen ties with the US LNG complex and expand gas storage; and the headline plan — a 「north diesel, south renewables」 posture: northern Taiwan is a net importer of 「南電北送」 power, Taipei’s solar capacity factor is 「about the same as Seattle’s」, onshore land is minimal, offshore wind underperforms in peak summer months, and the Datan and Tunghsiao gas plants plus finite northern LNG mean Taipei could run out of electricity in under one month if south-to-north lines are cut; for ~US$10 billion capex + ~US$500 million/yr to maintain, test and rotate fuel, the north could field ~2 GW of diesel generation (author’s own calculation) — about half the capex for a dedicated diesel stockpile and dispersed hardened storage, the rest for generators — enough to keep hospitals, cooling stations, sanitation, telecom and emergency services running in the north for roughly five months without southern power; a first tranche stood up by summer 2027 with exercises during the Urban Resilience drills, full buildout across 2028–2029; the south/center keep existing thermal plants plus onshore solar/wind that are hard to interdict; (7) the US-role limb — US firms to engage across the diesel/LNG/nuclear/solar-storage supply chain, and the chief US contribution judged to be preventing sabotage of south-to-north transmission and energy infrastructure, with the author asserting CCP intelligence services would use cyber and kinetic means including connections with criminal networks, so the US should rotate far more energy, counternarcotics and countersabotage personnel through Taiwan drawing on DOE, DEA, FBI and other civilian agencies through AIT; (8) the leverage limb — China’s food vulnerability and its steel industry’s dependence on Australian iron ore, plus economic/financial leverage, with the author’s own figure that net exports contributed 32.7% of China’s GDP growth, the highest since 1997; and (9) the policy-posture limb — Washington should underscore continued commitment to the 「One China」 policy anchored to the Taiwan Relations Act, the three communiqués and the Six Assurances while warning Beijing against aggression. Labeling: 「energy quarantine」「laying the groundwork」「dangerous new reality」「self-sufficient electrotech state」「increasingly outdated」 are the author’s framings carried as reported; the 2028–2029 peak, the $10B/2 GW/5-month arithmetic and the sabotage read are his estimates and his inferences, not findings of this archive (his own 「based on author calculations」 hedge retained); the inventory and percentage figures are the MOEA’s and the sources’ as he cites them and were not independently re-derived here; 「could」「might」「likely」「unlikely」 hedges are his and are retained; 跨國鎮壓 appears nowhere in this copy and no individual other than the author is named in it.

The limbs this surface alone carries:

(5) 學術 limb — 「國立臺灣師範大學一篇碩士論文發現，『不會』與『不客氣』在台灣華語中各有適用對象，兩者並不能任意替換」; named as 師大華語文教學系研究生黃家安 in 指導教授 洪嘉馡 指導下, 論文《臺灣華語回應感謝之語用策略及教學建議》, 於2024年出版, 方法 「自然對話、口語語料庫及問卷調查」, 歸納出 四種策略與九種說法（「不用客氣」、「不客氣」、「哪裡」、「不會」、「沒事」、「謝謝」、「嗯」、「好」, plus 什麼都不說也沒有肢體動作的「零形式」）; 發現 「不客氣」較適合長輩對晚輩、「帶有回絕對方客套態度的意味」，「不會」用在平輩之間或晚輩回應長輩、「間接化解對方的虧欠感」，「謝謝」適用於雙方存在互惠關係的情境; 論文並點出 華語教材把回應感謝的方式過度簡化、易讓學習者誤以為一說通用 — 「正好呼應外國網友『課本和現實不一樣』的經驗」.

(6) 英語世界 limb — 「美國語言學家丁金 (Aaron Dinkin) 曾讓學生在多倫多街頭向路人問路並道謝，共收集 1537次回應，整體有 41%回「you’re welcome」、31%回「no problem」，且越年輕越傾向說「no problem」；年長者視「no problem」為較隨意、只適合回應簡短道謝，年輕人則無此限制，該語正從敷衍轉變為禮貌用語」; plus 「《今日心理學》 專欄也提到，『You’re welcome』如今可能被解讀成帶點諷刺或炫耀，與台灣網友覺得『不客氣』像在邀功的感受相當類似」.

(7) 中國網友 limb — 「台灣人愛說『不會』的習慣，連中國網友也印象深刻。聯合新聞網2024年曾報導，一名中國男網友在小紅書分享向台灣人道謝、對方回「不會」，他雖不解卻覺得十分可愛；留言區有人提到**周杰倫〈半島鐵盒〉**開頭的女店員回的就是「不會」，也有人說「不會」等於不用謝、相當於台語的「免客氣」」. Attribution is the paper’s own — 「翻攝畫面」 with no link; the 聯合新聞網 2024 piece is not linked and not verified by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-30 — 【新聞稿】中國跨國鎮壓威脅升高，呼籲立委與政府 引入外國代理人法、完善反滲透法制 — 公民行動影音紀錄資料庫 (civilmedia.tw) (wire, canonical civilmedia.tw/archives/141899, 頁面日期 2026-10-30, 「文／民間司法改革基金會」 — i.e. the organizer’s own 新聞稿 carried verbatim by the publisher) — needs-tier t_7261971e. The Google wire redirect returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” to web_extract (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the redirect resolved in-browser and the full 正文 + 出席名單 was read there. Form matters for the ruling: this is the full-text civil-society-legislative leg of the 10-27→10-30 cycle — the 民間司改會 記者會 already ruled at t_8d460f1d (CNA photo series 「（1）/（2）(圖)」), now in the organizer’s own press-release surface with the complete speaker roster — not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the organization’s, the speakers’ and the paper’s as reported: (1) 民間司改會 2026-10-30 偕同 相聲演員 黃逸豪、立法委員 陳昭姿、黃捷，以及 西藏臺灣人權連線、華人民主書院、國際特赦組織臺灣分會、經濟民主連合 等團體代表在 群賢樓（台北市濟南路一段1號）召開記者會（記者會 10-30 09:30）; (2) the two demands — 修法將侵害個人權利的鎮壓行為納入《反滲透法》、考慮引入外國代理人登記制度，並強化對受鎮壓社群的保護支持措施（有效通報、資源整合、人員訓練、公私協力）; (3) 執行長 李明洳: 跨國鎮壓不只是國安、政治議題，更是人權議題; (4) case roll-call — 矢板明夫 遭攻擊、立委 沈伯洋 遭跟監攝錄、黃逸豪 遭車禍衝撞; 黃捷: 手法如出一轍，境外勢力以委託方式在他國以暴力、跟監、騷擾迫害批評者，「而且變本加厲當中」; (5) 在臺港人與圖博人同樣面臨威脅 — 香港行動者、華人民主書院專案經理 蔡智豪: 來臺後仍曾遭跟蹤、偷拍及個資外洩，書院活動曾遭偷拍監視、接獲炸彈恐嚇; 西藏台灣人權連線秘書長 札西慈仁: 中共長期以家人安危恐嚇藏人，藏人行政中央駐南非代表處今年遭汽油彈恐嚇及縱火; (6) 國際特赦組織台灣分會中國研究政策專員 方珊琳: 2024 研究報告揭露中港對海外個人與社群跨境打壓（歐美校園中國/香港學生處境），近年同樣現象在臺灣發生（卡米地 潑漆潑糞、香港行動者赴湯經營的泰拳館兩度遭潑紅漆、黃逸豪 實體攻擊）；「跨國鎮壓不能只被視為國家安全問題，它首先是一個人權問題」; (7) 律師、民間司改會跨國鎮壓研究計畫成員 宋易修: 一般刑罰無法評價來自他國的人權侵害、《跟蹤騷擾防制法》無法處理與性別無關的騷擾、第一線施暴者懲治無濟於事（「對威權國家來說，『人』不過就是消耗品」）; 黃逸豪: 「如果我當初沒有提告的話，警方是無法著力的」; (8) 經民連副秘書長 陳佑維: 境外金流多層斷點、績效只算「一件」→ 建議法務部提高跨國鎮壓案件績效權重（屬行政職權，不必等立法院修法）、必要時為審理跨國鎮壓及《反滲透法》案件法官提供安全協助; (9) 立法進度 — 陳昭姿:《國安法》與《反滲透法》草案分別在內政委員會停滯約半年與10個月，11-05 司法及法制委員會排定跨境鎮壓專題報告; 黃捷: 其《反滲透法》版本已納入跟監、騷擾、傷害、暴力，並建請內政部從入境端防範「中共慣用委託香港黑幫快速入境」手法; (10) 保護制度 — 蔡智豪: 保護措施必須真正到達受威脅的人，包括尚未取得公民身分者，「香港人的身分，不能直接被視為危險的證明」; 方珊琳: 現行以國安為中心、以刑罰為基礎的法制不足以保障潛在受害者，籲建立以受害者為中心的通報及支援制度. Labeling: 「中國跨國鎮壓」「境外勢力」「中共慣用委託香港黑幫」are the organization’s and the speakers’ framings carried as reported (this is the organizer’s own press release, so every characterization is advocacy-side attribution, not a finding); the 新北地檢 起訴 5 人 limb is 檢方 allegation (未判決、推定無罪); nothing here is a finding of fact by this archive.

Focus Taiwan / CNA English, bylined (By Sean Lin), 發布 10/29/2026 07:15 PM (Taipei), dateline 「Taipei, Oct. 29 (CNA)」. Body read in full this run — the Google wire redirect again returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” to web_extract and jina 403’d on news.google.com (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the canonical Focus Taiwan URL was fetched directly and the full article body read, including the sibling inline link 「● Five indicted over staged collision involving comedian critical of Xi」. Form matters for the ruling: this is the Cabinet-legislative leg of the 10-27→10-29 跨國鎮壓 cycle — the Executive Yuan announcing it is considering amendments to the Anti-Infiltration Act — not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the Cabinet’s and the paper’s as reported: (1) 內閣（政院）發言人 Michelle Lee（李慧芝） at the weekly Cabinet news conference: the government is considering legislation to penalize individuals who engage in 「transnational repression」 in Taiwan on behalf of an 「external hostile force」; (2) the instrument is amendments to the Anti-Infiltration Act（反滲透法） establishing penalties for such conduct; (3) conduct that could constitute offenses under the proposed amendments: surveillance, harassment and intimidation; (4) 「We will use clearer, more specific rules to protect public safety in the future」 and 「Once the required legal procedures are complete, we will submit the draft amendments to the Legislative Yuan as soon as possible」— both Lee’s quoted words; (5) the trigger named by the paper: a reporter’s question about attempts backed by the Chinese government to pressure people in Taiwan into making political statements; (6) the paper’s own named example — entertainer Kevin Tsai（蔡康永） recently posted apologies on Weibo and RedNote (Xiaohongshu) after appearing at an event marking the opening of the campaign headquarters for Puma Shen（沈伯洋）, the DPP’s Taipei mayoral candidate; Tsai wrote 「I have always hoped that the two sides of the [Taiwan] Strait can interact amicably. I have never supported Taiwan independence」 and apologized to business partners and fans he may have disappointed; many in Taiwan interpreted the posts as apologies made under pressure from China; Tsai has not commented on whether he made the posts under duress (the paper’s own hedge, carried as its labeling); (7) the paper’s context lines: Shen is an expert on China’s cognitive warfare and disinformation campaigns and is among 14 individuals, most DPP-affiliated, whom the CCP has designated 「die-hard Taiwan independence separatists」; and the 2016 comparison case — Taiwanese K-pop idol Chou Tzu-yu（周子瑜） of Twice issued a recorded apology after briefly waving Taiwanese and South Korean flags on a South Korean TV show, saying she was 「proud to be Chinese」. Labeling: 「transnational repression」「external hostile force」「pressure people in Taiwan into making political statements」are the Cabinet’s and the paper’s framings carried as reported; 「many in Taiwan interpreted Tsai’s posts as apologies made under pressure」is the paper’s characterization of public reading, not a finding, and the paper itself records that Tsai never said he acted under duress; the 「die-hard」 designation is the CCP’s. Nothing here is a finding of fact by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-27 — 加拿大跨黨派議員支持立法 打擊跨國鎮壓 | 大紀元 (wire) — needs-tier t_b653fca8. 大紀元記者 梁耀 採訪報導，【大紀元2026年10月28日訊】，更新 2026-10-28 7:44 AM，canonical epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/27/n14877969.htm，標籤 跨國鎮壓 / C-219法案 / 加拿大，責任編輯 田青. Body read in full this run in-browser from the live canonical URL (web_extract on the Google wire redirect returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” — the t_88e678ef read-text rule; the redirect resolved fine in-browser). Form matters for the ruling: this is the Canadian legislative-progress + cross-party-endorsement leg of the C-219 cycle already on this spine, not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the paper’s and the quoted MPs’ as reported: (1) C-219《國際反腐敗與人權法案》（亦稱《謝爾蓋·馬格尼茨基法第三號》）is Canada’s first law to write 「跨國鎮壓」 and 「良心犯」 into statute; passed 眾議院 and is now in 參議院二讀; (2) sponsor James Bezan 貝贊（保守黨，影子國防部長，2025-09-16 提出）三讀辯論 2026-10-08: the bill renames 《腐敗外國官員受害者正義法》→《謝爾蓋·馬格尼茨基法》、《特別經濟措施法》→《全球制裁與特別經濟措施法》（第二號）, first defines 良心犯 and 跨國鎮壓 in Canadian law, requires 外交部長 annual 國會報告 on 人權捍衛者/良心犯 work, raises 規避制裁罰款上限 to $100,000, and sets a 24-month timetable for confiscation of sanctioned persons’ Canadian assets, proceeds distributable to victims or government; (3) Bezan names 法輪功學員 as victims of 騷擾、威脅、襲擊及活摘器官 — he says he received a letter the week before the debate from a 多倫多法輪功修煉者 assaulted and death-threatened while protesting peacefully outside the 中共領事館, argues the attackers may hide behind 外交豁免權 and 「必須為此接受審判」; answering Ziad Aboultaif 齊亞德·阿布勒泰夫（保守黨）he said the 法輪功 group 「受到迫害和殺害，其器官被非法摘取並出售到世界各地」; answering Mario Beaulieu 馬里奧·博利厄（魁人政團）he cited evidence of 醫生 and others trading in victims’ 心臟、肺、肝、腎（「一種令人作嘔的行為」）and criticized 中共對維吾爾人 實施「再教育」、絕育及強迫勞動; he calls the amended bill less comprehensive than the original but 「對於未來現代化加拿大制裁機制至關重要」, and urges an 國際反腐敗法院; (4) Bezan names 壹傳媒創辦人 黎智英 as the typical 良心犯（「他是一名良心犯，我們必須營救他」，per Bezan 已判終身監禁）, and alleges 北京 has 警察站 in Canada and 至少干預過兩次選舉; (5) cross-party endorsements: 自由黨資深議員 Judy Sgro 思格若（10-20 對大紀元：「真正開始讓這些法律長出牙齒 put some teeth in these laws」）、外交部長國會祕書 Mona Fortier 莫娜·福捷（「提高透明度，並使加拿大的制裁制度現代化」；委員會修訂使年度人權報告不再公開列名個別良心犯以贯彻「不造成傷害」原則）、Chi Nguyen 阮芝（「加強加拿大的制裁制度，並更新人權框架」，選區居民關注海外親友所受政治鎮壓與任意拘留）、Sameer Zuberi 薩米爾·祖貝里（委員會曾聽取 藏人、維吾爾人、法輪功修煉者、香港人及受伊朗、俄羅斯鎮壓者證詞）、魁人政團 博利厄（支持擴大制裁、限制受制裁者家屬簽證、RCMP–FINTRAC 合作及資產沒收）. Labeling: 「跨國鎮壓」「良心犯」「活摘」「警察站」「干預兩次選舉」「再教育、絕育及強迫勞動」are Bezan’s and the paper’s framings carried as reported; the 多倫多領館外襲擊信 is Bezan’s account of a letter he received (no police charge or court finding named in this copy); the 黎智英 終身監禁 characterization is Bezan’s/the paper’s; nothing here is a finding of fact by this archive.

Substance retained, all of it the quoted 知情官員’s as reported: (1) 北檢已起訴 4 名台嫌、對港籍僱主 鞠覺賢、林慶 發布通緝，二港人「未在台灣設籍」，未來若有在台港人配合中共跨境鎮壓，「已經入籍的，會註銷其台灣身分，還在居留階段，不會讓他們定居」— the 廢止居留定居 policy signal is the only new content in this copy; (2) 「這二名港人並不是在台灣居留的港人，明顯有集團在背後跨國指揮」，委託的香港人才是重點，因為是跨境鎮壓的來源; (3) 台港司法互助幾乎停頓、港府不會交人，引渡有困難，故制度目標是「抓得到、判得重」，在出境前逮捕到案; (4) 法務部正研議修正《反滲透法》加重其刑，境外鎮壓犯罪不應再視為個人法益、須視為侵犯國家法益才能判重刑，否則現在都是違反個資法等輕罪; (5) 對照例：印太戰略智庫執行長 矢板明夫 在台中遭暴力攻擊、行兇者也是香港人、檢方起訴五年（「揍一拳就5年」，不再視為單純傷害案），以及「中共派女房仲在美國跟拍、蒐集賴總統家人的資訊，在美國這種罪判很重」。Labeling: every characterization above is the anonymous 知情官員’s (unnamed, so no actor row — t_c143aa9a precedent); 起訴 remains allegation (未判決、推定無罪), 通緝 is a prosecutorial measure not a finding; 「境外敵對勢力」「跨國指揮」「有集團在背後」are the official’s framing carried by the paper, and our own 安保協會 record still notes 未證實 港籍委託人與中國官方機關間的具體指揮關係. Nothing in this copy is a finding of fact by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-13 — 《國有器官》在台放映屢遭恐嚇 陸委會：不容境外勢力剝奪民眾知情權 大紀元 (wire) — 大紀元記者戴德蔓 2026-10-13. Same event as the LTN wire above. The Canadian documentary《國有器官》, which exposes PRC forced organ harvesting through testimony of practitioners and victims’ families, drew bomb, gunshot and cyber threats against multiple Taiwan cinemas and related organizations during its run; on 10-08 陸委會 invited the production team — director 章勇進 (Raymond Zhang), producer 宋美馨 (Cindy Song), 台灣法輪大法學會理事長 蕭松山, 新唐人記者 張東旭 — with 法政處長 周鳴瑞 receiving, to 關心 the intimidation and interference they faced. 周鳴瑞 framed the pattern as 跨國鎮壓: threats against screening venues and interference with distribution are aimed not only at individuals but at the public’s right to know. 宋美馨 said the pressure shows Beijing trying to “把這個 黑手伸進台灣”; the team thanked 警方 and government units for safety support during the screenings. Tier D for the named subjects — 章勇進/宋美馨/蕭松山/張東旭/周鳴瑞 have no relationship or presence in our archive (grep of content/ returns no person or org pages), so no pages minted; the community is not a named party in this item, the theme is ours. Ruling consistent with needs-tier t_45219d6b. The archive does hold the shape this event repeats: 2025-06-23 — 立法院外交及國防委員會邀請國安局、文化部、 警政署、陸委會報告「從『國有器官』在台播映困境看中國對台灣的長臂管轄策略，及我國的因應方案」 (陸委會：中國來台交流人士經過精心挑選), so the pattern is ours on file, not this year’s headline.

Reported. 2026-10-21 — 中共買凶要撞殘台灣喜劇演員 陸委會：協助跨國鎮壓絕不寬貸 自由時報 (wire) — needs-tier t_538d0391. 自由時報記者陳鈺馥 台北 2026-10-21 14:58, news.ltn.com.tw/news/politics/breakingnews/5613696. Substance retained, all of it the 檢方’s or 陸委會’s as reported: 黃逸豪 uploaded the Shorts 「獨辱習不如眾辱習」 in 2025-12 (習近平 修憲稱帝、小學畢業拿博士) which drew a strong response, then planned 專場演出 at 卡米地俱樂部 for 2026-05-29/30; on 2026-05-29 PRC-directed men threw 屎彈 at the club’s gate and interior, panicking the venue and audience, and 台北地檢署 concluded the case was 中共 透過暴力實施「跨境鎮壓」; undeterred, a PRC national nicknamed 「K」 then paid NT$450,000 to 前徵信業者 鄭博軒 to collect 黃男’s 個資 and 生活作息 to stop his 2026-09-20 show; from 2026-07-25 through 08 鄭男 ran 跟監 and fitted a GPS tracker to 黃逸豪’s 機車, delivered the data to 「K」 for a NT$250,000 前金, then plotted the car attack with 游幃捷, aiming to make 黃男 殘廢 — the result was only 右骨盆挫傷. 陸委會’s statement is quoted in full: it 高度肯定 新北地檢署 指揮警調 迅速偵破, condemns 中共 以暴力對台灣人民進行跨國鎮壓 with 「最嚴厲的譴責」, warns that anyone taking 中共或其協力者’s 指示、委託 or 利誘 to 參與或協助跨國鎮壓 will be 「依法究責、追緝到底，絕不寬貸」, and pledges 跨機關合作及相關法制 so people are 免於境外敵對勢力的恐嚇、騷擾、傷害或脅迫. New in this copy is not the case and not even the vocabulary (the 陸委會 「跨國鎮壓」 escalation was already recorded under t_77f8677c) but two date precisions this filing states more cleanly than its siblings: the Shorts upload month (2025-12) and the 卡米地 潑糞 date (2026-05-29), which the 風傳媒 copy left as 「今年5月29日」 relative to its own dateline. Labeling: 起訴 = allegation, not a finding of fact; 「K」 remains unnamed in the reporting; every characterization above is 檢方’s or 陸委會’s quoted statement.

Reported. 2026-10-21 — 【禁聞】中共跨國鎮壓鎖定逾萬人 美加反制 wire (NTD b5) — needs-tier t_c53fb57f. 新唐人電視台【禁聞】segment, 北京時間 2026-10-22 01:56, a104143996, 編輯/採訪 李韻、後製 鐘元. Body read in full from the live NTD b5 URL (the Google News redirect returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” — the t_88e678ef read-text rule; URL resolved by search). This is the fourth publisher-side filing of ONE story — the 《涉政落查人員庫》 大紀元 exclusive (n14872026, 記者冷鋒), already triaged on this spine as t_e58ab73c (大紀元 original), t_8dbfccc6 (NTD condensed rewrite a104143841) and, via that ruling, NTD’s verbatim syndication a104143646. This copy is the 【禁聞】 TV wrap: the database core is restated, not advanced (《涉政落查人員庫》 from the PRC 政法系統, 24,170 records / ~10,000+ people after dedup, 大紀元 itself states it cannot independently verify overall accuracy; overseas-platform accounts on X / Facebook / 大紀元 / 新唐人 / 文學城 resolved to real name, ID, address, work unit and family; ~22,500 records (93%) carry a mainland location and of the ~10,500 with a domestic residence, 4,783 are pinned to a door-address, with the reporting’s own caveat that a China address may be pre-departure or a family address). What is new in this copy is not the database but the two interview blocks and one piece of colour: 界立建 (called 「中國民主黨國際聯盟主席」 here) says 「一萬多人的統計數據，只少不多」, that 大數據 monitoring now sweeps 民運領袖、活動參與者、自媒體網紅 and 「意識形態能帶給大家覺醒的倡導者」, that the 「海外反賊名單」 and 「漢奸展覽館」 sites look 民間牽頭 but their 技術、網路支持、經費資金 are 「背後肯定是中共國家安全部去統一撥款」, that 納粹 and 恐怖分子 alike observe 「禍不及家人」 whereas this practice 「株連、軟禁受害者國內的親人」 makes it 「跨國恐怖犯罪」 deserving 馬格尼茨基 accountability — and the item reports that he has submitted evidence of CCP 跨國迫害 to the FBI and to Congress. 盛雪 (called 「民主陣線副主席」 here) gives the 統戰-system framing: the apparatus predates the PRC, its core method is 鎖定目標人物 and collecting all their information so that 軟肋、日常生活、關係網、朋友、家人 become 「打擊對手的槓桿」; it grew 「更加激進蠻橫」 after 習近平 took office, seeding 線人 across sectors; and the 退出黨團隊 campaign is a way to remove the system’s 著力點. The item also attributes to her 偽造色情圖片, 冒名發布炸彈威脅 and 連坐 persecution of her mainland relatives. Every characterization above is the speaker’s, attributed: no indictment, filing, or court finding is cited, and nothing here is recorded as established fact. The closing 反制 roll-call (加拿大 C-219 三讀, 美參院《制止跨國鎮壓法案》, DOJ 優先事項) restates legislation already carried on this spine.

Reported. 2026-10-23 — Suspected Chinese spy pleads not guilty to targeting Taiwan leader’s kin wire (INQUIRER.net US Bureau) — needs-tier t_356d22dc. The 7th triage of ONE case on this spine — United States v. Wanying Zhang, aka “Heather” (18 U.S.C. § 951), already carried under t_83a964c2 (2026-10-14), t_7979cbe0 (10-17), t_bca025f2 + t_35ee8f07 (10-19), t_2a804da6 (10-20), t_928b9374 (10-20). The Google News redirect is inaccessible (t_88e678ef read-text rule), and INQUI’s own URL served a Cloudflare interstitial (Just a moment..., 5.8 KB) while The Online Citizen 403’d, so the body was read in full from CBS News (Josh Boswell, CBS News Investigative Unit, 2026-10-23 5:15 PM EDT, cbsnews.com/news/wanying-zhang-alleged-chinese-agent-pleads-not-guilty/) and NBC Los Angeles (Helen Jeong, Danielle Smith & AP, 2026-10-23, nbclosangeles.com/news/local/irvine-spy-china-fbi-lax/3960062/), which carry the same event and the same quotes as the INQUI wire. Ruling made on read text, not on the wire headline. What this filing advances is the court posture, and only the court posture: Zhang pleaded not guilty on Friday 2026-10-23 at the post-indictment arraignment in federal court in downtown Los Angeles — the step our pages carried as scheduled, now held. She appeared in a white jumpsuit and shackles, speaking only to deny the charges. The judge set a pretrial hearing for 2026-11-12 and trial to begin 2026-11-30 at the federal courthouse in Santa Ana, estimated to last four days — dates that were not in the archive before this filing. Both prosecutors and defense counsel Craig Harbaugh declined to comment. Husband Edric Ding (realtor at the same Irvine firm) had appeared at earlier hearings and did not appear Friday, after prosecutors claimed in a recent filing that Zhang was having an affair with the man who accompanied her on the alleged Washington-state surveillance; CBS again names him as Fatai Miao, not charged, who left Southern California on a one-way ticket to China, and whose son denies any wrongdoing. NBC/AP add the Presidential Office statement attributed by name to spokesperson Karen Kuo (「a classic case of transnational repression」, 「Taiwan condemns in the strongest terms such barbaric acts…」) and the Chinese Foreign Ministry’s reply (not aware of the incident; opposes 「hyped-up accusations of ‘China spying’」). Labeling unchanged: indictment = allegation, no finding of fact, defendant presumed innocent until proven guilty (推定無罪); every characterization above is the speaker’s own, attributed.

Reported. 2026-10-22 — 中國民主黨國際聯盟揭中共20多宗跨國鎮壓 大紀元 (wire) — 大紀元記者陶若水紐約報導 2026-10-22 09:24 AM, n14874264, 責任編輯 鄭樺. Body read in full from the live epochtimes b5 URL (the Google News redirect is JS-only — the t_88e678ef read-text rule; URL resolved by search, and the 阿波羅新聞網 syndication carries the identical text, author 陶若水, 責任編輯 李華 — publisher-side editor drift, not a text variant). This is NOT a sibling of the 《涉政落查人員庫》 cluster already on this spine under t_e58ab73c / t_8dbfccc6 / t_c53fb57f: that story is the leaked 24,170-record database; this one is a street action — 中國民主黨國際聯盟 (CDPIA) held a rally on 2026-10-18 in front of the Queens Library in Flushing (王后區法拉盛圖書館前), a 華人-concentrated public venue, with display boards showing photographs of Chinese police visiting members’ families, footage of the assault on 民運人士 at the earlier Washington protest, and phone/微信 threat recordings played over a loudspeaker to passers-by.

What the item alleges (all attributed; no finding of fact). 主席 界立建 says that around the September 2026 visit to the U.S. by 習近平 and the organization’s Washington protest, the alliance holds evidence of 20+ cases of intimidation, threats and harassment against members and their families; some were threatened before departure, gave up protesting, and were harassed anyway. Named first-person accounts: 徐其仁 (江西) supplied a call recording in which local 國保 personnel, having taken his mother to a 中共社區機構 and phoning him in front of her, said they knew of his CDPIA membership and his dealings with 界立建, demanded he withdraw, referenced his pregnant wife, warned his mother could be implicated and that he faced imprisonment if he returned to China. 張劉敏 (河南鄭州) and 方碩 (江蘇) each received threat calls before the Washington trip — 張劉敏 threatened with her child’s safety — both stood down, were harassed regardless, and were told to leave the alliance and cut contact with 界立建 or 「後果自負」; 張劉敏 said she would not withdraw and would publicize the case and pursue legal accountability. 界立建 said the harassment is not confined to families in China: the alliance’s Malaysia web administrator 楊佳 was followed and threatened and dare not return to his residence, and members in Thailand feared rendition to China. Rally attendee 李中平 said Flushing was chosen precisely because it is 華人集中, and called on the U.S. government to investigate CCP agents operating illegally in the U.S. and to protect threatened people. 界立建 said the alliance is collecting names, recordings and video to submit to the U.S. government, Congress and international human-rights bodies under the Global Magnitsky Act, and urged targets to report and preserve evidence.

Tier ruling — Tier D for every named subject; no page minted. The CONTROL §1b discriminator is party status, and it returns Tier D here even though the venue is a U.S.-soil 華人 public space and the theme is genuinely ours: the people named as targets are members of a Chinese-dissident organization, their surveilled families are in mainland China (江西, 河南鄭州, 江蘇), and the two cross-border legs are Malaysia and Thailand — not 台美人 subjects, not families surveilled here. The U.S.-soil element in this item is the rally, not the repression. No 台美人 target, no action against any person or organization we record, no families-surveilled-here claim. Precedents: t_c53fb57f (界立建 as quoted interviewee), t_c0953057 / t_63ba370b (non-U.S.-soil legs of this theme), t_50d337d5 / t_c143aa9a (no pages for unnamed groups).

Why this belongs in Echopedia

Per CONTROL §1b, the Tier D↔E discriminator is whether the community is a party, not whether the story is famous. It is:

  • The targets are members of, or adjacent to, the diaspora we record — 台灣人 abroad, 僑界, Hong Kong residents in U.S. cities, and family members of public figures.
  • The operations occur on soil where our members live: Los Angeles, the San Gabriel Valley, Toronto, university towns across the U.S.
  • Our archive carried the evidence before the current cycle made it a headline.

Labeling standard: every claim below carries its status. Sourced = a document in this archive. Reported = press assertion we have not independently verified. Alleged = accusation in a filing or statement, recorded with attribution and without a finding of fact. Nothing is omitted for being uncomfortable; nothing is asserted beyond what the record holds.
